title: Colonel Sanders resembles Confucius
content: Kentucky Fried Chicken has opened more than 3,000 branches in China, and now the restaurant chain is more profitable in China than in the USA. One theory for KFC's boffo success: Colonel Sanders resembles Confucius.More chicken lore in this month's Smithsonian magazine:How the Chicken Conquered the World, by Jerry Adler and Andrew Lawler
